title: Kerovan Support, yearly (USD)
description: Kerovan Support is a yearly package from Scalytics for Kerovan, a reconciliation and evidence add-on for tokenized assets. It runs self-served on the Kafka you already have: Lascaris, or Confluent, Apache Kafka, Amazon MSK, Redpanda or Strimzi. Kerovan keeps on-chain tokens and the off-chain legal register and bank ledgers in step, holds what looks wrong until a person approves it, and records every decision in a signed audit log. It is a read-only plugin: data never leaves your environment and nothing writes back. It signs NAV and price data at the source, and can connect to EVM networks and Canton, the oracle you already use, and your custody system. It is for heads of fund operations, reconciliation, risk and compliance at fund administrators, transfer agents, custodians, and banks issuing tokenized deposits or funds.
